description: This file contains utilities and strategy definitions for context parallelism sharding rules related to scaled dot product attention operators in PyTorch's distributed tensor framework. It includes functions to register and unregister sharding strategies for various attention mechanisms with context parallelism support.

methods.name: _op_strategy_context
methods.description: Context manager for temporarily setting and restoring operator strategies for context parallelism.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_cp_strategy
methods.description: Defines a sharding strategy for flash attention with context parallelism support.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_backward_cp_strategy
methods.description: Defines a sharding strategy for backward pass of flash attention with context parallelism support.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_efficient_attention_cp_strategy
methods.description: Defines a sharding strategy for efficient attention with context parallelism support.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_efficient_attention_backward_cp_strategy
methods.description: Defines a sharding strategy for backward pass of efficient attention with context parallelism support.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_cp_strategy
methods.description: Defines a sharding strategy for cuDNN attention with context parallelism support.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward_cp_strategy
methods.description: Defines a sharding strategy for backward pass of cuDNN attention with context parallelism support.

methods.name: register_cp_sharding_rules
methods.description: Registers context parallelism sharding rules for all scaled dot product attention operators.

methods.name: unregister_cp_sharding_rules
methods.description: Unregisters context parallelism sharding rules and restores original strategies.
